messages:
Alex (partnerships): Quick sync — proposing a 2-week SI bootcamp for new systems integrator partners in June. Goal: hands-on labs (marketplace + private), a certification badge, and a co-marketing plan to accelerate the first pilot deals. Need curriculum draft, lab infra (1-2 A100s), evaluation criteria, and a marketplace + joint announcement checklist. Thoughts?

Maria (enablement): Love it. I can own the curriculum. Can we split into beginner vs advanced tracks? Will scope learning objectives and assessment items.

Derek (sales-eng): We'll add SI TAM shadowing slots for live customer demos. For marketplace listing, vendor checklist needs legal + vendor-ops signoff — I'll loop them in.

Natalie (SI-trainer): I can run the hands-on sessions. Need a repeatable infra template (Terraform) and sample prompts/artifacts. Can we get 5 test partner accounts and a sample dataset?

Leo (infra): We can provision a private sandbox: 2x A100 for heavy demos and 4x V100 for smaller isolated labs. Will need network peering rules and KMS/HSM access for the private deployment labs. ETA: ~7 business days after ticket.

Alex (partnerships): Great. Maria — can you draft a 3-day curriculum per track by next Wed? Natalie — can you prepare a lab runbook and prompt bank? Derek — please cc legal and vendor-ops on marketplace requirements. Also want a certification badge — who owns the LMS / badge issuance?

Maria (enablement): I'll create the curriculum doc and include rubrics. LMS is with LearningOps; I'll @learningops in the doc and request badge creation rules/metadata. Draft link: https://docs.google.com/si-bootcamp-curriculum (work-in-progress).

onboard-bot: Ticket #4521 created: "SI Bootcamp — curriculum + infra + cert". Assignees: Leo (infra), Maria (enablement), Natalie (SI-trainer). Due date: 2026-04-10.

Derek (sales-eng): For co-marketing, propose a joint webinar in the week after the bootcamp and a short case-study template for early partners. I'll draft a comms plan and PR blurb and share a timeline.

Alex (partnerships): Can we include a "private deployment" lab that walks through VPC + KMS + on-prem gateway? Also add a short marketplace checklist snippet below for quick reference. :thumbsup:

Alex (partnerships): ```
- legal-approval: signed EULA & marketplace terms
- listing-assets: logo (512px), 2 screenshots, 60s demo video
- infra-template: terraform/main.tf + README
- test-accounts: 5 partner accounts provisioned
- security-review: KMS access + network peering reviewed
```

Natalie (SI-trainer): Sounds good — I'll convert that into lab tasks and step-by-step runbooks. Can someone drop a small sample dataset (S3 link) and sample evaluation prompts?

Maria (enablement): I'll add pass/fail gating and a rubric with thresholds (70%+ for badge). Will include sample quiz items and an automated eval checklist.

Derek (sales-eng): Pinging legal — no major blockers flagged so far. Also drafting the webinar CTA & partner outreach template.

Leo (infra): Provisioning started. I'll share a terraform module repo once ready: https://git.internal/infra/si-bootcamp-template (private). Will include docs for KMS and network rules.

onboard-bot: Update: Ticket #4521 status changed to "in progress" (2026-03-22T15:04:00Z).

Alex (partnerships): Thanks everyone. Weekly sync Friday 9am PT from now until launch. Agenda: curriculum review, infra status, comms draft, certification gating. Ping here for blockers. :calendar:
